int(na): na via I_F2I; fault via $op.int_strict (InvalidCast). Default: REVIEW 4.2

barstate table: contract is 00-INDEX 3.6.5 as written; isnew_false_rt_confirm reads barstate.isnew false in step_bar of a REALTIME bar. Default: 00-INDEX 3.6.5
the na column of every ta.* overload with a source argument: propagate for ta.change, ta.mom, ta.roc, ta.swma, ta.alma, ta.linreg, ta.percentrank; skip for the others (REVIEW 4.1 W5 note, unverified)
